summary.headline: StradVision signs KRW 3.75bn supply deal with ASUX Components India for front-camera recognition solution
summary.what_happened: StradVision, Inc. filed a corrected disclosure on a single supply contract to deliver a front-camera recognition solution to ASUX (Aptiv Advanced Safety & User Experience) Components India Pvt Ltd, a shareholder of the company, with supply in India. The correction changed the counterparty name, which now appears as APTIV INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED in the revised filing. The contract period runs from Aug 19, 2026 to Jun 16, 2027, with payment due 90 days after invoicing and no advance payment.

summary.why_it_matters: Supply contract disclosures in Korea are required when a contract exceeds a set share of a company's recent revenue, and they let shareholders see the scale and timing of new business. Corrections such as a change in counterparty name are typically made to keep the public record accurate and do not by themselves change the contract terms.
